title: fix(types,layout,app-shell): a nav entry's inline locale-map label passes the door and renders in the viewer's locale; three inert nav resolver props retire (objectui#11299)
body:
Fixes #11299
Clause-②: yes

A navigation entry's `label` written as an inline locale map (the spec's `I18nLabel`, for example `{ en: 'Accounts', 'zh-CN': '客户' }`) is now accepted by `objectui validate` as the spec accepts it, and it renders the viewer's entry. The three nav resolver props that objectui#11201 left inert are removed.

This follows triage's answers on the card (comment `5922552691`): Q3 first, then Q1 A, with Q2 on the same call sites.

## What changed

**Q3: the authoring door (`@object-ui/types`).**
- `NavigationItemObject.label` takes the spec's `I18nLabelSchema` by reference (`stripImportedDefaults(SpecI18nLabelSchema)`, the same crossing `base.zod.ts` uses). It was `z.string()`.
- `NavigationEntryItem.label` is now the spec's `I18nLabel` type.
- The `doc` arm reads its base keys off the flat object, so it takes the same label.
- The empty-string refusal (`refuseEmptyNavLabel`) is unchanged. It is still the one stated divergence from the spec.

**Q1 A: the locale (`@object-ui/layout` plus five console mounts).**
- `NavigationRenderer` gains an optional `locale` prop. `resolveNavItemLabel` gains a trailing `locale` argument.
- `presentNavItemLabel` hands that locale to the spec's own `resolveI18nLabel`. There is no copy of its fallback order.
- The console passes `useObjectTranslation().language` from five mounts: `UnifiedSidebar` (both the app and home mounts), `nav-menu-renderer`, `CommandPalette` and `SearchResultsPage`.

**Q2: the retirement.**
- `resolveObjectLabel`, `resolveDashboardLabel` and `resolveViewLabel` leave `NavigationRendererProps`.
- `resolveNavItemLabel` loses its 2nd, 4th and 5th arguments. Its signature is now `(item, t, targetLabel, locale)`.
- The callers no longer build those resolvers: `UnifiedSidebar` keeps only `appLabel` from `useObjectLabel`, and `nav-menu-renderer` drops `useObjectLabel` entirely.
- `nav-menu-renderer.tsx`'s header comment no longer promises "convention-based object / view / dashboard i18n resolution". It now describes the rule the sidebar actually applies.

## Zone 2 measurements

1. **Q3 red reproduced before the fix.** The new pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/nav-label-locale-map-11299.test.ts` ran against the unfixed mirror. It reported `Tests 7 failed | 8 passed (15)`, with `invalid_type` at `label`, and the spec's `NavigationItemSchema.safeParse` accepted the same entry. The 8 rows that passed are the string control and the refusal rows. After the fix the file reports `Tests 15 passed (15)`. The spec (17.5.0) exports `I18nLabelSchema` and `I18nLabel` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`.
2. **Where the language comes from.** `UnifiedSidebar` resolves area labels as `resolveInlineI18nLabel(area.label, language)`, with `language` from `useObjectTranslation()`. It does not call `resolveAreaLabel`, which belongs to `AppSchemaRenderer` and has no locale. `useNavTargetLabel` reads the same `useObjectTranslation().language`. That value is the `locale` passed at all five mounts.
3. **Callers (`git grep`).** The card counted "three in-tree mounts and two tests". The measurement found more:
   - **Six-argument `resolveNavItemLabel` calls:** `CommandPalette`, `SearchResultsPage`, `nav-menu-renderer`, app-shell `views/metadata-admin/previews/navItemLabel.ts` (not named on the card), and `packages/plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx` (not named on the card, and a fourth released package). Tests: three layout files and app-shell `navItemLabel.inherit-11196.test.ts`.
   - **Props:** the two `UnifiedSidebar` mounts. Tests: app-shell `useNavigationSync.standardEntryLocalizes-11201`, `StudioDesignSurface.standardNavEntries-11201`, and layout `labelVerbatim-11201` and `navLabelOwnership`.
   - **`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`'s `resolveObjectLabel` is unrelated.** It is a local alias of `useListFieldLabel().objectLabel`, used for export naming. It is not the nav prop and was not touched.
   - **One more consumer, found by the build.** The Q3 type widening surfaced `packages/plugin-designer/src/NavigationDesigner.tsx`: four reads passed `item.label` to the keyed-label reader (TS2345). It now goes through a small `labelDraftOf` helper that keeps the runtime behaviour: a string and a keyed reference read as before, and a map starts the draft empty, which is what the keyed read answered for a map.
4. **`AppSchemaRenderer`: not taken.** Taking a locale would add a public prop to `AppSchemaRendererProps`. Nothing in this repository mounts that component with a locale to give it, so it fails the "no extra surface" condition. Only its `resolveAreaLabel` docblock is edited, so that it stays true: it no longer says that a nav entry label is the keyed form, and it states that the component's entries read the same `en` floor.
5. **The header comment** is true, as described above.

## Tests

The final union ran at `81579bca12` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`):
`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/ packages/layout/ packages/plugin-designer/ packages/app-shell/src/layout/` plus the 74 app-shell test files that `git grep -l` finds for `NavigationRenderer`, `resolveNavItemLabel`, `resolveObjectLabel`, `CommandPalette`, `SearchResultsPage` or `nav-menu-renderer`. Result: `Test Files 443 passed (443)` and `Tests 8875 passed (8875)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

New pins:
- **`nav-label-locale-map-11299.test.ts` (types).** The map passes `safeValidateSchema` and the strict face exactly as the spec's `safeParse` does, with a string control. A parity table checks that the mirror's verdict equals the spec's for nine label shapes (keyed reference, non-string entry and non-locale key refused by both).
- **`NavigationRenderer.labelLocaleMap-11299.test.tsx` (layout).**
  - zh-CN reads `客户`, and no locale reads the `en` default.
  - A parity table checks that `resolveNavItemLabel` equals the spec's `resolveI18nLabel` for twelve (map, locale) pairs, which pins "no copy of the fallback order".
  - The sidebar renders the group heading, the entry, the action and Favorites, and search finds the entry, all in the given locale.
  - The retired props and the six-argument call are `@ts-expect-error` lines. The layout `type-check` compiles them, so a re-added prop or argument fails that check.
- **App-shell rows for every mount** (sidebar app mount, `nav:menu`, palette, search). Each renders a map-labelled entry under zh-CN and under en, through a real `I18nProvider`; the sidebar harness uses its mocked `language` instead.

Ablation:
- `presentNavItemLabel` was changed to drop the locale (the `locale` argument of its `resolveInlineI18nLabel` call became `undefined`), applied with `ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor count went from 1 to 0 and the file's blob hash changed.
- Five files went red: `Tests 12 failed | 29 passed (41)`, covering every zh-CN row across layout and the four app-shell surfaces.
- After the restore, the file's blob hash equals its HEAD hash and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- The subject resolves through the vitest alias to `packages/layout/src`, so no build was needed between legs.

Console needed five plugins built first (`plugin-gantt`, `timeline`, `map`, `markdown`, `tree`): its first run reported only TS2307 "cannot find module" for those packages, which means a prerequisite was missing, not that the type-check failed. |

How the lint was narrowed:
- The population is the files `eslint.config.js` lints, run as the per-package `eslint .` runs (inline config honoured).
- The JSON output shows 23 files, 0 of them ignored, with 0 errors and 75 warnings. The warnings are pre-existing, on lines this diff did not write.
- Type-aware linting is not enabled (`tseslint.configs.recommended`; there is no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file.
- Under `--no-inline-config` there are 3 errors. All of them are on pre-existing `eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/static-components` lines.

Changesets:
- `@object-ui/types` `minor`
- `@object-ui/layout` `minor`, with the break spelled out: the retired props, the six-argument call, and the new prop
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`
- `@object-ui/plugin-designer` `patch`: no visible change

## Acceptance notes

None of these was filed as a card. Each has no carrier unless named.

- **`useNavPins`** stores `resolveNavItemLabel(item)` with no locale, so a pinned map-labelled entry's portable favourite record keeps its `en` text. The ruling names five mounts and this is not one of them. No measured pull: no readable app writes a map entry label.
- **`plugin-designer`'s `navigation-designer`** has two gaps:
  - Its preview rows and the app creation wizard call `resolveNavItemLabel` with no locale, so a map reads `en`.
  - Its inline rename starts a map label's draft empty, and committing typed text would replace the whole map with a string. The Studio's own designer avoids this with `renamedLabel` (objectui#11128).
  - Both behaviours predate this PR. The type change only made them visible. This is read off the source; I did not run a probe. Nothing in this repository mounts the component.
- **An empty map `{}`** is accepted, as the spec accepts it, and renders `''`. The empty-string divergence was not extended to maps, because doing so would widen a divergence from the spec that no ruling covers.
- **The pending `.changeset/11201-nav-label-verbatim.md`** said that the three props "are still accepted, so no caller breaks" and that the sidebar is not told the viewer's locale. Both sentences were corrected in patch round 1 (`ccd2a9b296`), together with two label-type parentheticals in `.changeset/10867-app-wizard-saves-spec-app.md`.
- **`ROADMAP.md` (P1.15)** still ticks "Wired into `NavigationRenderer` via optional `resolveObjectLabel`". It is a historical checklist and was left as is.

## Notes for review

- The file surface grew beyond the claim, in each case forced by the ruled changes: `packages/plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx` (the signature), `packages/plugin-designer/src/NavigationDesigner.tsx` (the type), app-shell `metadata-admin/previews/navItemLabel.ts` (the signature), and a docblock-only edit to `AppSchemaRenderer.tsx`.
- Commit trailers follow `AGENTS.md`'s model-free pair.
